correctness.rationale: YHK Pólya-urn root daughter sizes are uniform and daughter subtrees are conditionally independent. originality.rationale: Originality refers to the full root daughter-size conditional first/two-second-moment profiles and the extreme-root mean-invisible variance increase, not previously known marginal Yule cherry moments. Exact primary text inspections identify marginal cherry and cherry-pitchfork results but no conditional split/cherry bivariate law; closest research records concern other tree models or statistics. Residual historical-priority risk is acknowledged.
residual_risks: The mathematical result is an explicit consequence of standard YHK Markov branching plus earlier cherry marginal moments, so a previously published general root-split joint law or older equivalent formulation could subsume it.
Harding 1971 primary full text was not independently inspected.
Theorem does not establish the statistical power of a variance-sensitive hypothesis test.

value.rationale: The result reveals exact four-boundary localization of two moments linking the local cherry index to global root imbalance, for all n >= 10 and arbitrary root-size functions. The rare event that either root daughter has <=2 leaves has unchanged cherry mean but an exact 2/45 conditional variance elevation. It identifies a precise first-moment-blind dependence statistic for standard evolutionary null trees rather than simply recomputing a marginal.
